items.label: DOJ-CIVIL civil: GlaxoSmithKline, LLC
items.detail: Civil False Claims Act settlement announced with the guilty plea over adulterated drugs from the Cidra, Puerto Rico plant; date is the announcement date. The release states a $750 million resolution: 'a criminal fine and forfeiture totaling $150 million and a civil settlement under the False Claims Act and related state claims for $600 million' ($436,440,000 federal share and up to $163,560,000 to participating states). The criminal part is the separate $150 million row.

excluded_amounts.reason: Not counted here: the same dollars are counted once on cpr:c7c4c2f10fd99:3687 (overlap group crim-gsk-2010). DOJ release of 26 Oct 2010 (U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Massachusetts copy, justice.gov/archive/usao/ma/news/2010/October/GSKPressRelease.html, read 2026-10-11): SB Pharmco Puerto Rico's plea agreement carries one 'criminal fine of $150 million including forfeiting assets of $10 million'; the release names no non-prosecution agreement and no second criminal payment. The Corporate Prosecution Registry lists the same $150,000,000 again on a non-prosecution-agreement record dated 21 Oct 2010 (cpr:r946:946), the plea's own plea date. One payment, counted once, on the plea row. The $600M civil settlement is not a row here.
